statement: A tank at a fish hatchery holds $1{,}800$ liters of water. When the drain is opened, the amount of water left in the tank $t$ minutes later is $W(t) = 1{,}800 - 45t$ liters. How many minutes after the drain is opened will the tank hold $630$ liters?

choices.misconception: I divided 630 by 45 and got 14, but 630 liters is the amount left in the tank, not the amount that has drained.
I divided 1,800 by 45 and got 40 minutes, which is when the tank is completely empty, not when 630 liters remain.
I added 630 to 1,800 instead of subtracting, then divided 2,430 by 45 to get 54.

hints: Solve $1{,}800 - 45t = 630$ by first finding how much water has drained.
$1{,}800 - 630 = 1{,}170$ liters have drained, at $45$ liters per minute.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
